Author: Proteu
Name: Ultimate Rotation Guide
Punchline: Shows one player's ability order from an FFLogs ultimate pull.
Description: Loads one job's public FFLogs rDPS parses for an ultimate, grouped by percentile, and shows that player's ability order. In the selected ultimate, the guide starts at the pull and follows the fight, and it resets if you leave or wipe. Automatic rotation is off until you enable it. It then presses each due step for you, including on a striking dummy, and skips a step that cannot be used. The settings window has Parses, Actions, and Rotation pages. The guide stays on the Rotation page. Start on countdown presses the current step when the countdown reaches 1, at the end of that second, before the countdown finishes. Queue button presses holds the next action so the game can store it during the last half-second of the animation lock and use it as that lock ends. A step whose cooldown has not returned is held for up to 8 seconds and used when it comes back. Actions shows each ability as an icon. A bright icon may be used, and a dimmed icon is skipped. Mitigations and Gemdraught stay off until you enable them.
